title: Fixed or Deleted? External Feedback Lets Cheaper AI Coding Agents Repair Rule Violations
abstract: arXiv:2611.29162v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many defects violate project rules that the code itself does not reveal, such as layering constraints or required tests. We study whether LLM coding agents repair such violations better when an external checker reports them, with their location and a repair goal. Three models, a small, medium and large model, driven by an AI agent, worked on 25 pull requests with 31 planted defects in ten open-source projects, plus 5 correct controls, five times alone and five times with findings from CodeAssure (CA), a commercial checker. We also compare with GitHub Copilot code review, and compare CodeAssure's detection with nine free static-analysis tools run out of the box, including Semgrep and SonarQube Community. translated_title: 修复还是删除？外部反馈让更便宜的AI编程智能体修复规则违规
translated_abstract: 摘要：许多缺陷违反了代码本身无法反映的项目规则，例如分层约束或必需的测试。我们研究了当外部检查器报告这些违规及其位置和修复目标时，LLM编程智能体是否能更好地修复此类违规。由AI智能体驱动的三个模型（小型、中型和大型模型）处理了十个开源项目中25个包含31个植入缺陷的拉取请求，外加5个正确的对照组，分别在无外部反馈和结合商业检查器CodeAssure（CA）检测结果的条件下各运行五次。我们还将结果与GitHub Copilot代码审查进行比较，并将CodeAssure的检测能力与九个开箱即用的免费静态分析工具（包括Semgrep和SonarQube Community）进行对比。只有当修复后的代码能够编译并保留原有功能时，该次运行才被计为成功修复。实验结果显示，CA的检测结果使最小模型的修复率从26%提升至69%，中型模型从46%提升至90%，大型模型从45%提升至93%。
tldr: 研究发现，引入商业检查器CodeAssure等外部反馈（报告违规位置和修复目标）能大幅提升AI编程智能体修复项目规则违规的成功率，使更小更便宜的模型（修复率从26%升至69%）接近甚至逼近大型模型的修复效果。
en_tdlr: External checker feedback (such as CodeAssure findings with violation locations and repair goals) dramatically improves AI coding agents' repair rates for project rule violations, enabling smaller and cheaper models to approach the performance of larger ones.
